name: Food Processing
description: Value addition for grains, pulses, spices, dairy, fruits, and local crops through cleaning, grading, processing, packaging, and distribution.
growthPotential: High demand from urban consumers, institutional buyers, and regional retail channels.

name: Electronics
description: Assembly, repair, testing, components, and support services for electrical and electronic products.
growthPotential: Strong fit with EV, solar, consumer electronics, and industrial maintenance demand.

name: EV
description: Electric vehicle support ecosystem including components, charging support, retrofits, service, and light assembly.
growthPotential: Growing two-wheeler, fleet, and commercial EV adoption creates local service and component demand.

name: Renewable Energy
description: Solar installation, mounting, maintenance, energy audits, and local energy services.
growthPotential: Rising commercial, farm, and residential energy needs make local solar services attractive.

name: Packaging
description: Packaging products and services for food, pharma, retail, ecommerce, agriculture, and manufacturing units.
growthPotential: Packaging grows with every local product, ecommerce seller, manufacturer, and food processor.

name: Pharma
description: Pharma-adjacent services such as packaging, logistics, documentation, testing support, and compliant facility services.
growthPotential: Telangana's pharma ecosystem creates opportunities for compliant support businesses.

name: Agriculture Equipment
description: Small farm tools, implements, repair, fabrication, and localized mechanization support.
growthPotential: Farm productivity needs create steady demand for affordable equipment and service businesses.

name: Textiles
description: Garmenting, uniforms, home textiles, fabric value addition, stitching clusters, and local retail supply.
growthPotential: Institutional uniforms, workwear, and local garment demand support small manufacturing units.
